The locations is a bit unfortunate with a mix use of commercial properties around it. The house features a covered front porch, grand staircase, pressed tin ceiling, paneled wainscoting, baseboards, original mantels, tall ceilings, claw foot tub, updated kitchen and pocket doors. item.title: Pretty details! Has a pool! Circa 1931 in Florida. $279,900
item.description: This house has some pretty details inside! And a big bonus, it has a new roof. The house was built in 1931. It is located on .58 acre in Live Oak, Florida. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, brick fireplace, wide baseboards, updated kitchen, chair rails, crown moulding, french doors and wainscoting. There is a pool and a detached storage building on the property. Four bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,150 square feet. $279,900 Contact Mindy Wilkison with Poole Realty: 386-209-7

item.title: Diamond in the Rough! C. 1858. Over an acre in Georgia. $219,900!
item.description: This house looks like a diamond in the rough! Love the original details! The house was built in 1858. It is located on 1.32 acres in Linton, Georgia. The house features double front porches, original wood floors, baseboards, tall ceilings, stained glass, vintage light fixtures and a spacious kitchen. There is an old barn and a garage on the property. Five bedrooms, one bathroom and 4,300 square feet. $219,900 Contact Shannon Jones with Watkins Real Estate Associates: 478-232-0891 From the Zillow

item.title: Hawaii time! Dream setting! Waterfalls are pretty! C. 1920 in Hawaii. $1,200,000
item.description: Hawaii time! This is a dream setting! Wish they showed the waterfalls, stream and pools better! The house was built in 1920. It is located on .41 acre in Hana, Hawaii. The house features multiple lanais, window seating, wood floors, updated kitchen and a vaulted ceiling. This is a three section ohana-style home. item.description: Such beautiful views from this cottage! This lake cottage was built in 1912. It is located on .26 acre in Harrison, Idaho. item.title: On 57 acres in Illinois! Mid-Century modern. Beautiful setting! $450,000
item.description: Really nice acreage with this house! Love the setting! This mid-century modern house was built in 1943. It is located on 57.89 acres in Carbondale, Illinois. The house features a porch, a large deck, vaulted ceiling, a wall of windows, large fireplace, knotty pine, wood floors and exposed beams. There are multiple outbuildings on the property and there is a large pond. Four bedrooms, three bathrooms and 4,120 square feet. $450,000 Contact Daniel Harshbarger with Keller Williams Pinnacle: 618-867

item.title: Look inside this former schoolhouse! On 2 1/2 acres in Indiana. $300,000
item.description: Take a look inside this former schoolhouse! It has been renovated and updated nicely. The school was built in 1880. It is located on 2.5 acres in Brownsville, Indiana. The house features wood floors, exposed beams, bead board, large wood burning fireplace, spacious kitchen, large soaking tub and a beautiful front door. There is a one car garage on the property.
